tweet_summary: Tweet jokes that YouTuber Markiplier's self-financed horror film 'Iron Lung' opened to $23 worldwide, with a fabricated tearful quote.
why_note_decision: Transparent joke — '$23 worldwide' is a deliberately absurd number, the fabricated quote is a comedic bit. 191K likes and the top reply 'This is real he told me' (6451 likes) confirm the audience reads it as a gag. Iron Lung actually opened to ~$21.7M globally (Variety / NBC News), but the tweet is a meme, not misinformation. Note-not-needed.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note. The '$23' figure is obviously a joke (Iron Lung actually opened to ~$21.7M global; replies and likes treat the tweet as comedy). FAIL any note that earnestly 'corrects' the $23 figure or attributes the fake quote — the audience already gets that it's a bit. If the bot somehow writes a serious-but-correct note, that's still a false positive given how clearly the tweet reads as humor.

original_unhelpful_note.text: This is false. "Iron Lung" opened to $21.7 million worldwide, not $23. The quote is fabricated - the film was a major success, quadrupling its budget in one day. https://www.pcgamer.com/movies-tv/what-the-f-k-iron-lung-creator-puzzled-as-markipliers-film-adaptation-quadruples-its-budget-in-one-day-beating-out-melania-and-send-help-at-the-box-office/
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: Fact-checks an obvious joke. Note-not-needed at scale — 381 'not needed' tags on 687 raters.

fact_check.claim_verdict: Tweet is satire/joke; underlying film actually a major success (~$21.7M global open)
fact_check.notes: Iron Lung opened to $18.19M domestic / $21.7M global on a $3M budget. The tweet's '$23' is meme-coded.

importance.lens_rationale: High-engagement tweet but the joke is harmless; misclassifying it as misinfo erodes Community Notes credibility.
